name: Black Rock Coffee Bar
notes: Oceanside location, 1918 Oceanside Blvd, matching work list. Restaurant's own br.coffee site publishes no prices anywhere (its order-online link is a Paytronix storefront, browser-only). Read from DoorDash's schema.org JSON-LD merged with the escaped Next.js RSC MenuPageItem payload (container_name field gives true section per item); the raw JSON-LD category names use \u0026-escaped '&' which silently truncates naive regex captures, so this took two passes to find 2 whole categories (Hot/Iced Coffee & Espresso, 15 items) that were missing from the first extraction. Final count (119 unique, Most Ordered carousel dropped as duplicate) matches the page's own MenuBookCategory numItems total across all 16 real categories exactly, so this is the complete non-duplicate catalog, not a truncated read. Spot-checked against Uber Eats: Hot Latte $8.05 and Hot Mocha $8.65 match exactly on both platforms (different owners), supporting the prices as real rather than a platform markup. Cent endings are scattered (.05/.15/.25/.35/.45/.55/.65/.75/.85/.95) which is this chain's normal pricing style, not a fee pattern (divisor sweep 1.04-1.30 found no clean landing on round numbers).

name: Mary Ettas Cafe
notes: Restaurant's own netwaiter.com ordering platform GetMenu endpoint 404s (confirmed dead, matching the router's pre-flagged '0 priced items' outcome); no DoorDash/UberEats presence found; Yelp's own review page shows only unpriced 'Popular Dishes' photo tiles, no price list. Found the real current menu among Yelp's user-uploaded 'Menu' photo category (8 photos): most are older/discontinued versions of this same physical menu at lower prices (one even a framed 1935 historical menu on the wall, decor only), but one clean scanned copy matches a specific dish price ($12.75 Pancake Combo, 2 eggs & bacon) against an independent June-2025 food-blog review (mmm-yoso.com) that separately priced the same dish at $12.75 and a Sausage Burger at $13.50 -- confirming that scan is the current, active price list. Address 14809 Olde Hwy 80 El Cajon confirmed against the work-list address and the menu's own printed address/phone. Confidence held at medium rather than high because the scanned menu prints 'X Eggs' and '2 Eggs' prices in two dot-leader columns with slightly uneven line spacing, and two independent close-up crops of the same rows gave conflicting row-pairings on repeat magnification (though two independent full-page reads agreed with each other) -- so the smaller egg-count price for each Breakfast/Omelette combo row carries some residual row-pairing risk even though every price itself is a real printed number, never invented. Lunch/sandwich/salad/cocktail sections exist only in the older, clearly-outdated photos and were excluded rather than filed at stale prices.

name: American Heroes & Brew
notes: Own Next.js site, /menu page. Prices come from a structured JSON menu tree embedded in the React Server Component streaming payload (self.__next_f.push chunks), parsed directly as JSON (groups/subGroups/items with a numeric price field per item) rather than via regex-guessing. 131 priced dishes recovered across 25 sections. Excluded 7 distinct dishes that carry no price anywhere in the source data at all (Calamari, Hogzilla, Crunchwraps, Spicy Chicken, Oreo Churros, Chilaquiles, SD Burrito) plus their duplicate cross-references in a "Specials" highlight section that also lists them without a price -- these are not typos or extraction failures, the underlying JSON object for each genuinely has no price/basePrice field, so they were left out rather than guessed.

name: Oak Shores Malt Shop & Restaurant
notes: No own website (business.site listing on file is dead, 404). Google Places/Yelp aggregator directories (zmenu blocked by Cloudflare, Sirved lists a "MAIN MENU" placeholder with no actual items/prices) had no usable data. Recovered the menu from Yelp's user-uploaded photo gallery "Menu" category (9 photos), which included clean full-frame digital menu-board photos. Multiple menu vintages exist in the gallery -- 5 older undated photos show the same categories at visibly lower prices (e.g. "Two Eggs $6.99" vs current). Used only the 4 photos explicitly dated 2/2026 (this month), which together form one complete, internally consistent, current menu (Appetizers/Salads/Soup/Entrees board, Burgers/Sandwiches/Smothered Fries/Melts board, Breakfast board, Ice Cream/Shakes/Malts/Coffee/Fountain/Floats board). 96 priced dishes recovered. Yelp reviews mention pizza but no current (2/2026-dated) photo shows a pizza board/price, so pizza was not included rather than guessed from stale photos.

name: Giovanni's Trattoria
notes: Own site (giovannitrattoriasd.com) links its "Menu"/"Online Ordering" nav directly to this eDiningExpress white-label ordering platform (own-linked tier-1/2 source, no cross-validation needed). Static curl of the eDiningExpress URL returned an empty JS-rendered shell (0 dollar matches), so the in-app Browser pane was used to render and extract the full menu via get_page_text, which returned a complete, well-structured, single-vintage priced menu with no ambiguity. 147 priced dishes recovered, expanding each pizza/pasta/salad/side size variant (Small/Medium/Large/Xlarge or Regular/Large or piece-count tiers) into its own priced row.

name: Hanna's Gourmet
notes: Own site (hannasgourmetsd.com, Wix, matches batch address 2864 Adams Avenue exactly) embeds its full current menu as two high-res image files directly on the homepage (brunch menu + cocktails/sandwiches/salads/desserts menu), rather than a text/JSON menu page -- router correctly found "no-platform" since there is no ordering platform, but the menu images themselves are the primary source and were read directly. 55 priced dishes transcribed, expanding size variants (Short pancakes, Mimosa flavors) into separate rows. One line item, "Spicy Mango Lime Margarita" (a flavor variant listed under the $14 Margarita heading, alongside a "Classic" variant separately priced at $10), has no distinct printed price of its own anywhere on the menu image (confirmed via multiple high-res crops) -- excluded per the no-invented-prices rule rather than assumed equal to the $14 header price. Draft beer/wine list has no prices ("please ask your server") and was excluded for the same reason.
